cases.translation: The word of the Lord that came to Micah.
cases.explain: The phrase 'word of the Lord' uses the genitive Господа to express possession and source.

cases.translation: Hear, you peoples; listen, O earth.
cases.explain: The verb слушайте (listen to, hear) is transitive and takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Пусть Владыка Господь будет свидетелем против ___.
cases.translation: Let the Lord God be a witness against you.
cases.explain: The preposition против (against) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: Behold, the Lord comes out of his dwelling place.
cases.explain: The preposition из (from, out of) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Плавятся горы под ним, как воск от ___.
cases.translation: The mountains melt under him, like wax before the fire.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: За это я сделаю Самарию грудой развалин, среди которых разобьют ___.
cases.translation: Therefore I will make Samaria like a rubble heap of the field, like places for planting vineyards.
cases.explain: The verb разобьют (will break, will destroy) is transitive and takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Я низвергну ее камни в долину и обнажу ее ___.
cases.translation: I will pour down its stones into the valley and uncover its foundations.
cases.explain: The verb обнажу (will uncover, will lay bare) is transitive and takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Все ее истуканы будут расколоты, все храмовые дары ___.
cases.translation: All her idols will be beaten to pieces, and all her temple gifts burned with fire.
cases.explain: The short-form adjective сожжены (burned) agrees with the plural nominative subject дары.

reading.ru: Слово Господне, которое было к Михею из Маришета, в дни правления Иотама, Ахаза и Езекии, царей Иудеи.
reading.question: When did Micah receive the word of the Lord?
options: During the reign of one king
During the reign of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah
reading.correct: During the reign of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah
reading.explain: The text says the word came 'в дни правления Иотама, Ахаза и Езекии, царей Иудеи' (in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah).

reading.ru: Слушайте все народы. Внимай земля и все, что на ней.
reading.question: Who was called to listen to God's message?
options: All peoples and the earth and all that is in it
reading.correct: All peoples and the earth and all that is in it
reading.explain: Micah called 'все народы' (all peoples) and 'земля и все, что на ней' (the earth and all that is in it) to listen.

reading.ru: Смотрите, Господь выходит из своего жилища. Он нисходит и ступает по высотам земли.
reading.question: What does the text say about God's coming forth?
options: God comes out of His dwelling place and treads on the high places of the earth
reading.correct: God comes out of His dwelling place and treads on the high places of the earth
reading.explain: The text states 'Господь выходит из своего жилища' and 'ступает по высотам земли' (the Lord comes out of His dwelling and treads on the high places of the earth).

reading.ru: Плавятся горы под ним, как воск от огня, раскалываются долины, как вода, что льется со склона.
reading.question: What are mountains and valleys compared to in this passage?
options: They melt like wax and split like water pouring down a slope
reading.correct: They melt like wax and split like water pouring down a slope
reading.explain: The text uses comparisons: 'Плавятся горы под ним, как воск от огня, раскалываются долины, как вода' (mountains melt like wax, valleys split like water).

reading.ru: За это я сделаю Самарию грудой развалин, среди которых разобьют виноградники.
reading.question: What will happen to Samaria?
options: It will become a pile of ruins with vineyards broken up
It will be made a great city
reading.correct: It will become a pile of ruins with vineyards broken up
reading.explain: The text says 'сделаю Самарию грудой развалин, среди которых разобьют виноградники' (I will make Samaria like a rubble heap with vineyards broken up).

reading.ru: Все это за отступничество Иакова, за грехи дома Израиля.
reading.question: Why will these judgments come?
options: Because of the disobedience of Jacob and the sins of the house of Israel
reading.correct: Because of the disobedience of Jacob and the sins of the house of Israel
reading.explain: The text explains 'Все это за отступничество Иакова, за грехи дома Израиля' (All this is for the disobedience of Jacob and the sins of the house of Israel).
